CoSky 6.2 rebuilds the dashboard on Base UI and cuts its size by more than half. The server, SDK and APIs are unchanged from 6.1.

## Highlights

- **Dashboard on Base UI:** the UI components moved from Radix UI to [Base UI](https://base-ui.com/), and all styling now uses Tailwind theme tokens. The pages look the same.
- **Smaller dashboard:** the build drops from 14 MB to 5.5 MB because only the editor languages configurations use are bundled.
- **Clearer feedback:** a failed operation's message now includes the server's reason, for example `Delete config failed: <reason>`.
- **Editor:** `.yml` and `.properties` configurations are now syntax-highlighted.
- **Fixes:** the fullscreen topology no longer briefly renders twice when closed, and the sign-in page's animations stop when the system asks for reduced motion.

Upgrading from 5.x? Read the [6.0 upgrade guide](https://cosky.ahoo.me/guide/upgrade-6) first.
